title: 第3章 百日决战动员大会第4章 你不拿我不拿专员怎么拿
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
朝会仍未结束。
众臣对如何处置妖猴讨论不休。
四大天师之一的许天师手持玉笏，步出仙班。
“陛下，妖猴凶顽不假，然则上天素有好生之德。”
“依臣愚见，是否再遣太白星君下界招抚？晓以天恩，或可……”
话音未落，便被一位赤面神将打断。
“招安招安，招个鸟安。”
许天师还要辩驳，文曲星君微微摇头，出班请奏。
“那妖猴前番受封弼马温，已是天恩浩荡，但其非但不思报效，反作下毁天门、伤天王、戮天兵之大逆！
依我看太白第一次下界，已是一记昏招。”
“此乃丧权辱天庭之举！
此风若长，三界妖邪岂不视我天庭如无物？断不可再行！”
苏元在心中暗自记下。
天庭中文武各成一派，
目前来看，文官中似乎也是派系林立。
太白金星与许天师交好，此刻被文曲星君以妖猴发难之事怼的说不出话。
太白金星虽然位高权重，却也不好下场自救。
武将中早已有人按耐不住。
巨灵神声若霹雳。
“末将巨灵神，愿领一哨精兵下界！

定将那猢狲生擒活捉，砸碎他那花果山！”
魔家四将之首魔礼青脸色一沉，冷哼一声，也迈步出班。
“巨灵神，休夸海口！
那妖猴法力高深，凭你？”
“捉拿此等妖孽，须得我兄弟四人法宝齐出，方才稳妥。”
一旁的天蓬元帅，慢悠悠地神情倨傲。
“呵呵，两位将军何必争抢？区区一个猴头罢了，何须如此大动干戈？”
“本帅麾下天河十万水军，皆是精锐之师，翻掌之间便可踏平花果山，一战功成！”
他故意顿了顿，眼神瞥过巨灵神和魔家兄弟。
“怕是某些莽撞之辈，连那猴毛都未必摸得着，反添笑柄。”
“你说谁是莽撞之辈？！”
巨灵神怒发冲冠，四大天王面含冷笑。
更有药叉将、鱼叉将等李靖家将在旁边叫嚷不休。
最后还是李靖提出亲自下场，带十万天兵下界，众将方才停止吵嚷。
苏元又暗自记下，
武将中李靖派系势大，魔家四将果然与李家不睦。
二师兄如此倨傲，怪不得日后被坑了个惨的。
content_en:
The court meeting is not over yet.
The ministers discussed endlessly how to deal with the monster monkey.
Xu Tianshi, one of the four great heavenly masters, walked out of the immortal class holding a jade tablet.
"Your Majesty, it is true that the monster monkey is fierce and stubborn, but God has always been kind to you."
"In my humble opinion, should I send Lord Taibai Xing down to the lower realms again to appease me? With God's grace, Xiao Xiao may be able to..."
Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by a red-faced god general.
"Recruiting for peace, recruiting for peace."
Xu Tianshi still wanted to argue, Wenquxingjun shook his head slightly and left the class to ask for the performance.
"The demon monkey was granted the title of Bi Ma Wen, and it was already a great gift from heaven. However, instead of wanting to repay the favor, he committed a treacherous act of destroying the heavenly gate, injuring the heavenly king, and killing the heavenly soldiers!
In my opinion, the first time Taibai went down to the world, he made a mistake. "
"This is an act of humiliation and humiliation of heaven!
If this wind persists, won't the demons of the three realms regard my heaven as nothing? Never do it again! "
Su Yuan secretly wrote it down in his heart.
In heaven, civil and military forces each form their own faction.
At present, it seems that there are many factions among the civil servants.
Taibai Jinxing was on good terms with Xu Tianshi, but at this moment, Wenquxing was so shocked that he was speechless because of the monster monkey's attack.
Although Taibai Jinxing has a high and powerful position, it is not easy to save himself.
Some of the generals could no longer hold themselves back.
The voice of the giant spirit is like thunder.
"The last general, the Giant Spirit God, is willing to lead a sentinel of elite soldiers down to the realm!
I will capture that hozen alive and smash his mountain of flowers and fruits! "
Mo Liqing, the leader of the four generals of the Mo family, his face darkened, he snorted coldly, and stepped out of work.
"Giant Spirit God, stop boasting about Haikou!
That monster monkey has great magic power, how about you? "
"To capture these evildoers, we must have the magic weapons of all four of my brothers to be safe."
Marshal Tianpeng on the side looked arrogantly.
"Haha, why are the two generals fighting for it? It's just a monkey head, why do they need to go to war like this?"
"I have one hundred thousand Tianhe naval forces under my command. They are all elite troops. They can conquer the Huaguo Mountain with the flip of a palm and achieve victory in one battle!"
He paused deliberately and glanced at the Giant Spirit God and the Demon Brothers.
"I'm afraid some reckless people may not even be able to touch the monkey hair, which will make them a laughing stock."
"Who are you calling a reckless person?!"
The giant spirit god was furious, and the four heavenly kings had sneers on their faces.
There were also generals from the Li Jing family such as General Yaocha and General Harpoon who were shouting beside them.
Finally, it was Li Jing who proposed to go down personally and bring one hundred thousand heavenly troops down to the realm, and the generals stopped shouting.
Su Yuan secretly wrote down again,
Among the military generals, the Li Jing faction is the most powerful, and the four generals of the Demon family are indeed at odds with the Li family.
The second senior brother is so arrogant, no wonder he was tricked in the future.
